findings.evidence: Lines 103–104 only map an existing identity through `laurentEval`; Laurent/Basic.lean:116–126 defines that evaluation for noncommutative targets explicitly including endomorphism rings.
findings.fix: Replace `[CommRing S]` with `[Ring S]` and update the docstring.
findings.issue: `sub_inv_mul_laurentEval_laurentQuantumInteger` unnecessarily requires `[CommRing S]`, excluding evaluation at units of endomorphism rings.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Data/Nat/Choose/Basic.lean:86 provides `Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt`, which makes both sides zero when `n < k`.
findings.fix: State the same identity for arbitrary `n k : ℕ`; split on `k ≤ n` and discharge the other case by vanishing.
findings.issue: `cast_choose_mul_sub` unnecessarily requires `k ≤ n`; its ring-valued identity also holds when `n < k`, since both binomial coefficients vanish.

summary: Two scalar identities impose unnecessary restrictions on their public APIs.
